bills.heading: Open bills
bills.howItWorks: Bills arrive from your mail and from photographed letters: Yorik suggests them in the bell, you accept with one tap. A bill whose amount and payee show up on a connected bank account is ticked off by itself. Three days before the due date you get a reminder.
bills.formInvalid: Name and an amount above zero are needed.
